methods_quotes.q: Prevalences of depression, anxiety, PTSD, and suicidal ideation were stratified by demographic characteristics, workplace factors, stressors experienced, and coping mechanisms.
Bivariate PRs of the four mental health conditions were calculated separately using Poisson regression with 95% CIs.
Analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute); p<0.05 or CIs for the PR that exclude 1.0 were considered statistically significant.
